LaTeX: z=re^{i\theta}=r(\cos\theta+i\sin\theta)
CAS 표현: Eq(z, r * exp(I * theta))

역할: formula
LaTeX: r=|z|=\sqrt{x^2+y^2}
CAS 표현: Eq(r, sqrt(x**2 + y**2))

오개념 ID: em.complex.cartesian_polar_form.argument_uniqueness
